Early life[edit]Birth and christening[edit]Felipe de Marichalar y Borbón was born on 17 July 1998 at Ruber International Hospital in Madrid.
[3]He was baptized on Sunday 4 October 1998 day of the feast of 
San Francisco de Asis and on the eve of San Froilán, patron of Lugo, the mass was celebrated in the audience hall of the 
Zarzuela Palace. The ceremony was officiated by 
Archbishop of Madrid. His godparents were his maternal grandfather, 
Juan Carlos of Spain, and his paternal grandmother, Concepción Sáez de Tejada y Fernández de Boadilla, Dowager Countess of Ripalda (1929–2014).
